title: MV YEP's Event Chase Player; any way to make an "area"?

posts.author: Dusk_Funa
posts.body:
I'm using
YEP's Event Chase Player
to do evented encounters on the overworld.
What I mean by "area" is a designated spot an enemy will not leave no matter what...
...by using something like terrain tags, specifically.
I feel like specifying that I have this plugin isn't necessary, but it's helpful anyway. Here's the enemy event over there, too.
And the custom route in the first picture (all script calls):
this._chaseRange = 3
this._seePlayer = true
this._alertSoundVol = 80
Click to expand...
(the note <enemy> is for a plugin that allows for
preemptive/surprise attacks within events
.)

posts.author: RicoRob
posts.body:
You can use
Yanfly's Region Restrictions
to draw a limiting area. The event can't cross it, but the player can.
